title: The Weighted Palm Primer
summary: A first primer on loading the palm and fist with the pull of gravity so that a simple blow lands with far more weight.

title: A Handbook of Heavy Steps
summary: A handbook on stepping with the full pull of the ground in each footfall so the user cannot be shoved from place.

title: The Pull and Draw Workbook
summary: A workbook on drawing small objects and then limbs toward the user along a line of gravity felt through the palm.

title: Primer of the Sinking Guard
summary: A primer on letting weight sink through the guard into the ground so that blows lose their force in the user's stance.

title: The Burden Bearer's Drill-Book
summary: A drill-book on carrying and shifting heavy loads with qi and on placing that same load on a foe's shoulders.

title: Workbook of Falling Weight
summary: A workbook on dropping the body and the weight of a blow together from a rise so both land as one.
